title: Terms of use
updated: Last updated: 26 November 2026. Silver Vibe™ is a personal open-source project offered as-is. This short notice is a working draft; a lawyer should review it before you rely on it for customers in the EEA/UK. Contact

acceptance.title: Acceptance
acceptance.body: By creating an account or using the hosted apps at silvervibe.io (including product apps such as VibeStandup), you agree to these terms and to the Privacy notice. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

service.title: The service
service.body: Silver Vibe provides workspace tools for async standups and related team rituals. Features may change, break, or be withdrawn while the project is early. Source code is available under the MIT license on GitHub; hosting, branding, and the silvervibe.io domain remain under the project operator.

accounts.title: Accounts and workspaces
accounts.body: You must provide accurate sign-in details and keep credentials secure. Workspace admins control membership and which tools and add-ons are enabled. You are responsible for content you post (standup answers, polls, retros, feedback, meetings) and for complying with the rules of any third-party service you connect.

acceptable.title: Acceptable use
acceptable.body: Do not abuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, scrape in a way that harms availability, upload unlawful content, or use the product to harass others. We may suspend accounts that put the service or other users at risk.

disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
disclaimer.body: The hosted service is provided without warranties of any kind, to the fullest extent permitted by law.
